sentences.span: Non-farm payrolls increased by 162,000, of which private payrolls contributed 127,000, compared with consensus expectations for 55,000. Positive revisions added a further 55,000 jobs to prior months

UBS: 'the economic resilience contributing to this shift also supports our constructive investment outlook' vs DB: 'Markets are pricing a shallow hiking cycle despite underestimating the Fed's hawkishness... The market is pricing a modest adjustment. History points to a cycle.'
sentences.why: No bank disputes the payroll print itself; UBS and DB genuinely diverge on what a more-hawkish Warsh implies (constructive vs. underpriced-tightening), supporting the framing as a fair synthesis rather than an invented claim.
